label: ALMA-B20-B21 (Nordic nRF54LM20A/B)
pending_reason: ALMA-B20-B21 is under development. No u-blox RF or provisioning assets exist in this repository yet, and builds currently target Nordic's nrf54lm20dk rather than a u-blox board definition.

mac.source: Nordic FICR DEVICEADDR (random static Bluetooth address). As on NORA-B2, u-blox programs no address in production.
notes: Zephyr and NCS use the FICR address as the identity address by default; the beacon sample prints it as 'advertising as ...'.
